description.value: A community outdoor swimming pool in Hagensborg in the Bella Coola Valley, originally built in 1967 as a federal Centennial project. Operated by the Central Coast Regional District during summer months only, it offers public swims, lap swims, and Red Cross swimming lessons. For touring cyclists passing through one of BC's most remote valleys, it's a rare chance to cool off after a long ride through the Coast Mountains.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Centennial Pool is a publicly accessible outdoor swimming pool in Hagensborg, operated by the Central Coast Regional District, open June through August only. The phone number on the website (250-982-2488) matches the OSM record. Job postings for 2026 lifeguard/instructor positions confirm the facility is still active. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, showers, or any other amenities — though a public pool would typically have some of these, absence of evidence means null per the rules.
